title: Communist Propaganda Obtained In Western Chapei On 23-11-33

page_data.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No.
No. D 2554/43
Special Branch 25th April 1933

Date November 25, 1933.

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda obtained in Western Chapei on 23-11-33.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

I submit hereunder a summarized translation of a handbill
issued by the Shanghai Western District Committee of the Chinese
Communist Youth League, entitled "Political Contest", a copy of
which was obtained by Agent A-1276 in Western Chapei on November
23 :-

"Political Contest"

The masses are hereby invited by the Shanghai Western
District Committee of the Chinese Communist Youth League to
participate in this contest and answer the following questions:-
(a) Give the reason why since the establishment of the Kuomintang
the power of the imperialists has increased while the number
of unemployed is increasing daily.
(b) How is it that under Soviet rule all imperialists are
destroyed and the people prosper?
(c) Describe the difference between the present anti-communist
campaign of the Kuomintang and the four previous campaigns.
(d) What must we do to destroy the 5th Kuomintang campaign?
(e) What methods should be adopted by comrades in order to secure
the support of workers against the Kuomintang anti-Communist
campaign?
(f) In order to make the occasion an outstanding success, what
methods should we adopt regarding the Anniversary of the
Canton Uprising and the Convention of the Second National
Congress of Soviet Representatives on December 11?

（印：F.I. O.T.C.S.B.）
Copy of handbill
attached 25/11/33
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Copies to Messrs Stephen, Sady & Van den Berg
Officer i/c Special Branch.
78.you
